title: Close session prompt — round 3: Session details gets "In your lists" with Mark complete

steps.path: Status bar → tags element (also Resume → Organize, the side panel, a project's conversation)
steps.headline: Session details now has the close prompt's "In your lists" card: Pin to top and Mark complete together.
steps.changed: Pin to top was alone in an unlabelled card under "Tags". Now it sits under its own label, "In your lists", with Mark complete beside it — the same card as the close prompt, as you picked. Every place that opens Session details gets it.
steps.notice: Mark complete saves at once here, like the rest of Session details. Its line now says when it takes effect: "Leaves it out of the resume list once it's closed, unless you turn on Show complete."
steps.risk: The popup is about 80 points taller (428 to 511).

steps.path: Status bar → tags element → Mark complete
steps.headline: Marking the session you're in complete is safe: nothing changes while it stays open.
steps.changed: The switch turns on and its check fills. Resume never lists a session that is open, and the tab, the session lists and the chat ignore the mark — so you keep working as before.
steps.notice: Once you close it, it stays out of Resume unless you turn on Show complete, and Welcome back offers it unticked. Turn the switch off to undo.

steps.headline: The close prompt's card is now the very same one, so its Mark complete line reads the same.
steps.changed: Only the line under Mark complete changed, to the shared wording. The prompt still saves nothing until you press Close session.
